==Description==
'''Praise The Sun''' is an emote that could be obtained at Level 9 of the premium [[Ducky Revenge Event#Ducky Revenge Battle Pass|Ducky Revenge Battle Pass]]. It was made by Capra. The emote has no music which can be heard while it is performed, it is not moveable and it cannot be interacted with. The emote is also looped.

It had a cost of {{DuckyEggs|240}} or {{Robux|48}} ({{Robux|40}} during the Memorial Day 2025 Sale) to unlock it, with a total of {{DuckyEggs|1,150}} or {{Robux|460}} ({{Robux|387}} during the Memorial Day 2025 Sale).

==Trivia==
*The emote is likely a reference to the [[w:c:darksouls:Gestures|Praise the Sun]] gesture from ''Dark Souls''.
*The emote's description is a direct quote from Louisiana's state song [[wp:You Are My Sunshine|You Are My Sunshine]].
**This song has been heavily popularized on the internet thanks to the fans of professional American basketballer [[wp:LeBron James|LeBron James]], who sings this song to show appreciation towards the player.
